description: This file defines a Blazor layout component that manages refresh behavior through a singleton broadcast service.

classes.name: BlazorLayoutComponent
classes.description: A Blazor layout component that subscribes to refresh requests and triggers UI updates.

methods.name: OnInitialized
methods.description: Overrides the base method to subscribe to refresh events upon component initialization.

methods.name: CallRequestRefresh
methods.description: Public method to trigger a call to refresh the layout externally.

methods.name: DoRefresh
methods.description: Handles refresh requests by calling StateHasChanged() to update the UI.
